verses.1: And the word of Jehovah was spoken to Jonah for the second time.
verses.2: Go to the great city of Niniveh, and call out to it with the words I will speak to you.
verses.3: And Yona got up and went to Niniveh, as the Lord commanded. Niniveh became a great city for God. It remained in that state for three days.
verses.4: And Yona began to enter the city. After forty days, he called out and said, “It’s still forty days before I will die.”
verses.5: And the people of Niniveh believed in God. They called for help, and they wore clothes made of fine cloth, both large and small.
verses.6: And the message was brought to King Nino. He got up from his throne, stepped down from it, put on his robe, and sat down on the throne.
verses.7: And he cried out and said, “Oh children of the king! And all his nobles! Say that man and animal, in the morning and at night, should not be harmed. And water should not be polluted.”
verses.8: And the people and animals will be covered with cloaks. They will call out to God with strength. Then one person will leave the wrong path, and from the burden that is on their shoulders.
verses.9: Who knows whether God will return and bring peace? He will rise from his grave, and we will not be destroyed.
verses.10: And God saw what they had done. They had turned away from their wrong ways. So God comforted Himself over the evil that he had commanded them to do, but they did not do it.
